# Computing Education

> > A comprehensive German-language resource for computer science education research, teaching materials, and AI pedagogy with a focus on K-12 and teacher training.

Computing Education is a research-driven platform providing evidence-based teaching materials, curriculum frameworks, and publications on computer science and artificial intelligence education in German schools. The site emphasizes unplugged activities, hands-on learning, and critical perspectives on AI literacy alongside practical programming skills.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence Education
- Machine Learning
- Snap! Programming
- Reinforcement Learning
- Unplugged Activities
- Computer Science Education
- Teacher Training
- AI Literacy
- Data Literacy
- Quantum Computing
- Agile Methodology
- Teaching Methods
- German Education
- Bavaria
- Open Educational Resources

## Core Resources & Organization

- [Computingeducation](https://computingeducation.de): Homepage showcasing CS education research, projects, and learning materials
- [Über uns](https://computingeducation.de/about): Organization overview with team members and research focus areas
- [OER-Zeitschrift Informatische Bildung in Schulen](https://computingeducation.de/ibis): Open-access journal for CS education in German schools

## AI & Machine Learning Curriculum

- [SnAIp Part A – Reinforcement Learning in Snap!](https://computingeducation.de/proj-snaip-A): Curriculum framework for reinforcement learning using Snap! programming
- [SnAIp Part B – Unsupervised Learning in Snap!](https://computingeducation.de/proj-snaip-B): Curriculum for unsupervised learning and clustering in Snap!
- [Exploring the world of AI](https://computingeducation.de/proj-ki-mooc): MOOC course on artificial intelligence and machine learning basics
- [IT2School - Module zu künstlicher Intelligenz](https://computingeducation.de/proj-it2school): AI teaching modules for secondary schools with Orange3 and ML tools
- [So Lernen Maschinen!](https://computingeducation.de/proj-ml-uebersicht): Overview of machine learning algorithms and applications for learners
- [Data Cases](https://computingeducation.de/proj-datacases): Teaching method using data case studies for AI and data literacy

## Unplugged & Interactive Learning

- [TINAs Lernreise](https://computingeducation.de/TINA): Educational material on large language models, tokenization, and embeddings
- [Sprachmodelle unplugged mit Grimms Märchen](https://computingeducation.de/proj-grimm): Unplugged activity teaching language models using Markov chains
- [Schlag den Roboter – Maschinelles Lernen erfahren](https://computingeducation.de/proj-schlag-das-kroko): Interactive game teaching reinforcement learning via Hexapawn

## Teacher Education & Professional Development

- [Lehramtsstudium Informatik](https://computingeducation.de/proj-lehramt-marketing): Teacher education program guide for CS studies in Germany
- [Absolventinnen und Absolventen im Lehramt Informatik in Bayern](https://computingeducation.de/absolventen): Analysis of CS teacher graduates in Bavaria after 20 years

## Programming & Algorithm Instruction

- [Algorithmen mit Snap!](https://computingeducation.de/algorithmen-mit-snap): Visual programming guide for algorithms in Bavarian grade 11
- [Agile Schule](https://computingeducation.de/proj-agile-schule): Project-based learning using agile methodology in schools

## Specialized Topics

- [Quanteninformatik](https://computingeducation.de/proj-quanteninformatik): Educational materials on quantum computing and cryptography

## Research & Perspectives

- [Publikationen](https://computingeducation.de/publications): Research papers and publications on CS education and AI pedagogy
- [Künstliche Intelligenz ist kein Werkzeug](https://computingeducation.de/ki-werkzeug-bildung): Critical reflection on AI in education beyond application skills
